example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবন এখন অমাবস্যার অন্ধকারে ঘেরা।
example_sentences_in_english: His life is now enveloped in the darkness of the new moon.
The country's economy is submerged in the darkness of the new moon.
note: The idiom draws from the natural phenomenon of the new moon, symbolizing complete absence of light in Bengali folklore.
